purpose: Reference expectations for a later LLM interface; not loaded by query.py and not a measured model benchmark.

prompts: What changed in Central London between Q1 and Q2 2026?
Focus on City Core and City Fringe. Did they move in the same direction?
Give me two cited points for our meeting.
must_preserve: Savills source attribution
Q1 versus Q2 periods
rounded take-up precision
publisher-defined geography
source links on each finding

prompts: Compare the H1 Grade A rent observations for City and West End.
What evidence do we have for Midtown and Canary Wharf?
must_preserve: Average Grade A rent is not prime headline rent
Midtown has positive but slower annual growth
Incentive range is not a signed offer
No comparable Canary Wharf vacancy observation is present

prompts: What development and refurbishment evidence do we have?
Trace 2 Aldermanbury Square from pre-let to completion.
How much newly available space did that completion add?
must_preserve: Survey year 2025; publication April 2026
Starts and deliveries are different flows
66 percent refers to floorspace, not scheme count
All offices pre-let; do not count completed area as speculative available supply
Fit-out was to follow; operational occupation not established
Different historical area figures are not automatically a physical change

prompts: Show one significant office pre-let in our source collection.
What is the committed area and expected delivery?
Does 60% pre-let mean 40% of the office area remains free?
must_preserve: British Land publication 10 February 2026
Agreement includes area options
Building ERV and office floor area have different denominators
Future delivery is a forecast
1 Appold Street and tenant entrance 8 Exchange Square belong to the same scheme

prompts: What does our newest macro evidence say?
Separate London observations from UK-wide context.
How could this inform our office-market watchlist?
must_preserve: Policy meeting September 2026
Labour and GDP reference period June–August 2026
Publication dates differ from observation periods
Employment and unemployment denominators differ
Potential transmission channels are interpretation, not identified causal effects

prompts: What evidence is relevant to quality, sustainability and hybrid working?
Show a concrete London office energy certificate.
What exactly does that certificate establish?
must_preserve: H1 shares are not Q2-only observations
Hybrid survey is Great Britain, not London office occupancy
Certificate is second floor of 20 Triton Street only
Assessment 22 October 2024; certificate 23 October 2024; validity to 22 October 2034
EPC, BREEAM and Grade A are distinct
Portfolio leasing is not a market-wide estimate

future_refresh_acceptance.same_reviewed_source_loaded_twice: zero duplicate observations or new findings
future_refresh_acceptance.later_GPE_announcement_added: one project receives a new milestone with a new evidence link; old forecasts remain historical
future_refresh_acceptance.presentation_label: historical replay; newly ingested does not mean newly occurred
future_refresh_acceptance.implementation_status: not implemented by this evidence explorer
